mapping.sheet: Measured 1.60 mm → actual flange, rail and carrier extrusions; supported1.6–2.4 mm.
mapping.discs: Source pierced circular sheets and circumferential rectangular sockets → reconstructed circular/hex/octagonal coil end flanges with four radial sockets and clear central bore.
mapping.tenons: 4.50 mm source socket length retained as tongue width. Socket length 4.50+proposed total allowance .10–.30 mm; tangential width actual sheet+same allowance. Default4.65×1.75 versus measured source4.50×1.70. Not asserted to reproduce source fit.
mapping.tabs: Four low runners per part,24total, surrounding frame and crossbars; proposed .4–.6 mm runner thickness instead of source .21–.22. Breakaway widths .8–1.2 mm.
mapping.redesign: Six parts: two flanges and four identical seven-to-nine-mm radial web rails, with 4.5-mm end tongues. Clear bore20–32mm, winding span30–54mm. All8joints adhesively retained, no snap-fit claim. Signature lug engraving keeps≥1mm backing.
mapping.novelty: Builds an air-core skeletal coil former, not a solid thread spool, a switch fidget or a moving-link demonstrator. Geometry includes open bore, eight shoulder-supported socket joints, end tie holes and independently customized winding span. Wire/thread and optional compass external; no powered circuit or magnetic simulation.
